name: manipulative_dataset
description: A dataset for evaluating models' ability to detect and/or classify manipulative or persuasive language in text. It contains annotated examples of various manipulative strategies to measure robustness of classifiers to subtle persuasion and framing. The benchmark is intended for research on misinformation, persuasion detection, and safety-related content moderation.
reputation: Relatively niche dataset with modest adoption in research on persuasion and manipulation detection.
